# Second Brain v1.1.1

Updated presentation artwork designed by David in Figma: transparent banners and six-area maps for light and dark mode. The banners now include “A PERSONAL OBSIDIAN VAULT”. Superseded banner and map SVGs have been removed.

## Downloads

| Asset | Use |
| --- | --- |
| **Second-Brain-v1.1.1.zip** | Extract the complete vault, including hidden `.obsidian` settings. |
| **Second-Brain-v1.1.1-sources.zip** | Corresponding plugin sources, licenses, provenance and build guidance, with the updated template. |
| **SHA256SUMS.txt** | Verify both package checksums. |

[Quick start](../README.md#quick-start) · [Selective updates](UPDATING.md) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)

## Updating from v1.1.0

Replace the four banner/map PNGs in `system/assets/`. This release also updates asset documentation and removes the superseded SVGs from repository maintenance. Code, plugins, layouts and Obsidian configuration remain unchanged.

Back up your vault before applying changes. Previous releases remain available.

## Validation and limits

The new artwork was inspected on white and black backgrounds. Package integrity, template contents and structural links were checked. Native Obsidian tests were not repeated for this artwork-only update; macOS and Linux remain unvalidated.
